selection_reasoning: These 4 tasks form a coherent multi-hop structure. The player must first find dark_oak_stairs (a placed block in the scene), which establishes the location of dark oak materials. From dark_oak_stairs, the player can mine them to obtain dark oak planks needed to craft a dark_oak_button. In parallel, the player must find cyan_wool (a navigation/observation task) and then mine blue_wool (which is placed nearby). The dependency chain is: find dark_oak_stairs → craft dark_oak_button (finding the stairs provides the dark oak material source to craft the button), and find cyan_wool → mine blue_wool (finding cyan wool leads the player to the wool area where blue wool can be mined). This creates a DAG with two parallel branches that test both navigation/finding and crafting/mining skills.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the dark_oak_stairs structure (centered around [5.5, 0.5, 5.5] spawn-relative) and face toward it, modeling 'player can see the stairs'. Max distance 16 blocks and facing tolerance 60 degrees ensures the player is looking at the structure.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a dark_oak_button results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The player must mine dark_oak_planks (placed at ~5,0,4 / ~6,0,4 / ~5,1,4) and craft 1 dark_oak_button using any crafting grid (1 plank = 1 button). The crafted item ends up in inventory and is not in starting inventory.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the cyan_wool pillar (at [-5, 0, 6] spawn-relative) and face toward it, modeling 'player can see the cyan wool'. Max distance 16 blocks and facing tolerance 60 degrees ensures the player is oriented toward the target.

Uses inventory_has because mining blue_wool drops the blue_wool item which ends up in the player's inventory. The player must break at least 1 blue_wool block from the cluster at ~-6/-7, 0-1, 6-7 relative to spawn. Blue wool drops itself when broken by any tool or hand, so the wooden axe works fine.

scene_description: A cleared 20x20 grass field with two distinct areas: (1) A dark oak structure to the northeast containing dark_oak_stairs (6 blocks in a stepped formation) and dark_oak_planks (3 blocks) as crafting material, with a crafting table nearby; (2) A wool display to the northwest with cyan_wool (2-high pillar) and blue_wool (5 blocks in a cluster). The player spawns in the center with a wooden axe.
task_text: Find the dark oak stairs structure and use the nearby dark oak planks to craft a dark oak button at the crafting table. Also, find the cyan wool marker and mine the blue wool blocks next to it.
design_notes: Layout: Player spawns at center (0,0,0 relative). Dark oak area at +5/+6 X, +4/+5/+6 Z (northeast). Wool area at -5/-6/-7 X, +6/+7 Z (northwest). Crafting table at +3,0,+3 (between spawn and dark oak area). The dark_oak_planks are placed adjacent to the stairs to form a coherent 'dark oak structure' - finding the stairs naturally leads to the planks. Cyan wool is a 2-high marker pillar with blue wool blocks clustered around it. The 20x20 cleared area ensures all blocks are visible and reachable. Player has wooden axe for mining planks and wool efficiently.
